[Normalized measurements](../audit/session-recovery-0147.json) preserve availability, exact staged hashes, runtime pins, seven separate runs, supported durations and continuation attribution; [measuring script](../audit/metrics/session_recovery_0147.py) is saved.
All three initial workflows failed in Epilogue after successful packing/upload/download; the internal exception and point of output loss remain undetermined. Recovery succeeded with zero final recorded artifacts; control #669 published 12.
Later continuation added three Claude requests per affected session: nine total, 18 input and 5,543 output tokens; cache counters remain separate. Checkpoint gaps are not agent-active time, subscription quota or monetary cost.
Passed the issue's structural/equality verification plus staged-hash, run/step-pointer, transport-boundary, checkpoint-containment, continuation-total and file-size checks. No historical commands or probes were replayed and no missing artifacts reconstructed.
Next: Policymaker may request only the failing Epilogue error tails and executed engine revisions for the three named initial runs/jobs. If unavailable, retain the undetermined cause and close this audit; do not repeat the history survey or hold the iteration open.
Missing streams, original results bytes/boundary manifests, within-step logs, watchdog trace and historical publication events limit the conclusion. Benchmark readiness and product quality are unmeasured.
